title: Willow Lane Acquisition Corp. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-24
summary: Willow Lane Acquisition Corp., a SPAC, filed an 8-K disclosing an amendment to its Transfer Agreement with Sponsor and SPV (Goodrich ILMJS LLC), extending the deadline for the SPV to purchase 27.5% of founder shares and warrants from 6 months after closing to the earlier of (i) 6 months after closing or (ii) 15 days after the effective date of a post-closing registration statement, provided lock-up has expired. Securities will be held in escrow at Continental Stock Transfer & Trust Company pending consummation.
key_points: Willow Lane Acquisition Corp. is a Cayman Islands SPAC listed on Nasdaq (tickers: WLACU, WLAC, WLACW)
The SPAC has 4,628,674 founder shares and 4,007,222 warrants held by the Sponsor
The Amended and Restated Transfer Agreement grants Goodrich ILMJS LLC the option to purchase 27.5% of sponsor holdings at $1.75 per founder share
Closing deadline for the purchase is extended to earlier of 6 months post-closing or 15 days after registration statement effective date
Securities will be held in escrow at Continental Stock Transfer & Trust Company prior to transfer
Shareholder meeting to approve the business combination with Boost Run Inc. is scheduled for April 30, 2026
